hypothesis: 更新结束后存在可回收的不可达Python张量或空闲缓存；显式清理可降低随后的full-context验证峰值，而不改变数值状态。若不是这种生命周期问题，诊断应否决该修复。
state_invariants: 全部parameter及buffer字节哈希、dtype/device、对象及storage身份
全部AdamW moments字节哈希、storage身份、step counters、参数组lr/wd
numpy sampler和counterfactual sampler完整RNG状态；Python、torchCPU与MPS RNG状态
small_sequence: 使用真实属性但独立固定synthetic targets；3708/928形状按原顺序validation0→update1。在同一更新权重上先做完整validation，再执行一次屏障并重复完整validation；采用既定2e-6/阈值一致性，验证前后state不变。没有真实accuracy或选步。
full_sequence: 新进程/新输出中重新从原权重开始；真实属性构造完整inner6954/support和1739/query，synthetic targets，原3072/256 sampler与原fitseed。validation0→update1→唯一屏障→validation1→update2→唯一屏障→validation2。保持同一AdamW及全部moment对象，不能从旧失败进程/半成品resume。
data_policy: Read only explicitly selected train.csv attribute columns, excluding Transported; synthetic y=np.arange(8693)%2. Stratified train_test_split(.2,random_state20261112) on synthetic y gives6954/1739. Small case uses first3708 of this synthetic inner and first928 of synthetic validation, preprocess fit only small support. Full case fresh original model/preprocessing/optimizer/RNG on entire synthetic inner. No real targets or test answers; these IDs differ from real-label split, not exact replay of failed fit.
stage_separation: Release small-case model/optimizer/tensors and caches before creating fresh full-case state. Same original weight/backend/dual checkpoint/FP32+bf16; same moments persist across full update1 and2.
state_hash_observation: Record synchronized current/driver before hashing, after hashing and at each barrier substep. Snapshot hashes return scalar/byte hashes and metadata only, never retain GPU clones. Hashing copies toCPU and may perturb timing/allocator; do not call measurements peaks.
required_evidence: Complete state object/storage/bytes/RNG identity across each barrier
Small updated-weight fullvalidation before/after barrier <=2e-6 and identical .5 decisions
Full validation0, update1, barrier, validation1, update2, barrier, validation2 with original optimizer counters and unchanged moments
Actual full support/query forward coverage and finite probabilities at each validation
Substep gc collected count and current/driver snapshots, clean release
stop_rules: 任何权重/moment/step/RNG/输入字节或设备变化，或小形状概率/阈值不一致：否决修复。
完整实际顺序仍OOM、超出另行冻结deadline或无法完成第2次更新后验证：归档，不提高cap/减少support或query/改backend/precision/checkpoint/offload。
GC不能回收全部204MB并不自动等于失败；但若没有可记录的生命周期释放，只是一次偶然运行通过，不能据此宣称已证实根因。需要把结论限定资源可行性，不归因特定泄漏。
即使通过也只证明该固定诊断，不能伪造原CV逐值等效或已完成全量导出；另行root修复决定、新source/protocol及新proposal仍必要。
